content:
On behalf of the zulip moderators, let me announce that you can directly report problematic messages to moderators. (This has been enabled for a while, but as it's hidden enough, it deserves public mention.)

To report a message, click on the three dots next to a message (to show a list of menu items) a select "report message". Only the moderators can see that you reported a message, and what you wrote in your report.

You can use to report messages which you believe violate the community guidelines, but also for topics which should be moved to a different channel (for instance).

Perhaps you have used the #butterfly or :robot: emojis as a substitute for this feature: you're strongly encouraged to report these messages instead.
